content: March 1, 2024 Careers Key points NCEZID employs staff across a wide variety of professions. Join NCEZID to advance your public health career and make a meaningful impact. Find available job opportunities at NCEZID below. Our Mission NCEZID works to save lives through the prevention, early detection, and control of infectious disease threats. Our center employs staff across a wide variety of professions, including laboratory staff, epidemiologists, clinicians, health communicators, public health analysts, and more.
